name: Hosea
tagline: A faithful God and an unfaithful people
author: Hosea.
date: Ministry in the northern kingdom, about 750 to 722 BC.
setting: Israel falls into idolatry. Hosea’s marriage becomes a picture of God’s love.
theme: God loves his people even when they are unfaithful and calls them back.

outline.label: The unfaithful wife and the restored bride

christInBook: God’s patient love for an unfaithful bride, shown in Hosea’s marriage, points to Christ and his church. Matthew 2:15 applies “out of Egypt I called my son” to Jesus, and Paul quotes Hosea about Gentiles becoming “my people” (Romans 9:25).
howToRead: Hosea is a book of painful love. Watch for the shifts between accusation and tenderness. The names of Hosea’s children are messages, and they are later reversed.
